subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts be a first-party Control UI memory feature, part of a broader secured workspace-file manager, or a plugin-projected Control UI panel after the contribution-slot RFC is settled?
rationale: The request is useful but chooses storage, injection semantics, browser write authorization, and core-versus-plugin ownership that automation should not decide.

options.title: Set the pinned-context contract first
options.body: Define fact categories, freshness semantics, write path, diff/audit behavior, and owner boundary before any implementation PR.

options.title: Fold into memory/workspace files UI
options.body: Treat this as a structured view over USER.md or MEMORY.md only after the broader file editor or memory panel has the right safety controls.

options.title: Defer to plugin contribution slots
options.body: Use this issue as a concrete consumer for Control UI panel contribution APIs instead of adding a bespoke core panel now.

recommendation.title: Set the pinned-context contract first
recommendation.body: Define fact categories, freshness semantics, write path, diff/audit behavior, and owner boundary before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal across current product direction, gateway file safety, memory docs, and Control UI routing.
